Exact preceding player 'Come in' accepts invitation to enter manor. D33415:40–15:45 V/Cirren/Fenar enter western ground-floor receiving room of existing manor; Mara settles coach/four healthy horses in yard then joins. Existing elderly mortal castellan offers wine/bread/cheese/cold roasted venison as free guest refreshments, Fenar asks for meat; no extra V speech, resource use or new provisions added, no cost. Castellan says Lady Caul receives in upper gallery at dusk. Newly described mundane furnishings, not extra assets or appraisal. Same finite roster, no hidden areas searched, no combat. This was already narrated and accepted in conversation, recovered here without replay; no previous D334 folder/chunk existed at checked head.

Exact current player 'Sure. Inspect what we can in the meanwhile' accepts ordinary guest exploration while awaiting dusk audience. Castellan permits courtyard and public reception rooms; V and companions inspect available furnishings/heraldry. Mara observes genuine older workmanship and some designs consistent with Silverward's recovered House marks; castellan identifies household display relics as Silver Court and says Lady preserves them. This is newly specified accessible ordinary evidence consistent with fixed existing appropriation of ancient iconography and relics (long-arc-two-antagonists-dm-only.md §G), not newly invented genealogy register, personal proof, new magical object or appraisal. Counting room and upper private archive remain uninspected; castellan says access requires Lady's permission, no forced entry or theft. No contest/check for ordinary permitted viewing and conversation. As dusk falls ~18:30 D334, castellan escorts party to west upper audience gallery 30x40, south windows heavily shuttered; Lady Ysendre Caul emerges for actual agreed audience, elegant dark formal attire, no automatic recognition of V's ancient identity, speaks about Voss's message and asks what he seeks. Only what she received in actual letter and observed presently; no personal ancestry disclosed, no claims accepted, no charm, attack, initiative, combat or time-based injury. V next reply. Fixed private manor geometry and roster retained: Veteran at gate and receiving room, Guards yard and stair, Spy counting room, castellan escort, two spawn still cellar unless later actual orders/movement, Ysendre now gallery at night as prepared. No new funds, rest, provisions, transfer, or resource expenditure. Manor night and dusk timing approximate narrative local time, no calendrical/seasonal rules changed.
